body.Job description: I’m looking for an experienced lead researcher to help me find the right people to contact at 30 technology/software companies where I would like to work as an SDR/BDR in London. For each company, I would like you to find up to 12 relevant people who could potentially be involved in, influence, or provide insight into SDR/BDR hiring. This could include: * SalesDevelopment Representative /Business Development Representative/Account Development Representative Managers-Priority(1) * Head/Director of Sales Development-Priority (2) * * Current London/UK SDRs or BDRs -ONLY ONE PER COMPANY * Recently promoted SDRs/BDRs to Account executive or GTM- ONLY ONE PER COMPANY * Other people who appear directly involved in hiring or building the SDR team IMPORTANT: I do not need exactly 12 people from every company. Quality and relevance are much more important than quantity. Some companies may only have 3–6 genuinely relevant people, and that is completely fine. Also, please do not rely only on job titles. Here are two examples of the type of research I am looking for: EXAMPLE 1 – CLAY A recent person joining Clay as a London ClayDR thanked Baily B. and Rob Cook for their interview process and warm welcome. These are the types of connections I want you to uncover — people who were actually involved in hiring, interviewing, managing or building the SDR team, even if their job title isn't simply “SDR Manager.” LinkedIn profiles: Baily B.: https://www.linkedin.com/in/baily-brogden/ Rob Cook: https://www.linkedin.com/in/rob-cook-clay/ EXAMPLE 2 – SEMRUSH Another person recently announced that they had joined Semrush as a Business Development Representative. In their LinkedIn post, they specifically thanked Ozhan Gunes and Timothy Miller for giving them the opportunity. Again, these are exactly the types of people I want identified because this suggests they may have been involved in the recruitment, interview or hiring process for the BDR team. LinkedIn profiles: Ozhan Gunes: https://www.linkedin.com/in/ozhan-gunes/ Timothy Miller: https://www.linkedin.com/in/timothy-miller-51ba62157/ Please use this type of research across the other companies. In particular, look at LinkedIn posts from: * People who recently joined the company as SDRs/BDRs * SDR/BDR managers * Recruiters * Sales/GTM leaders * People recently promoted from SDR/BDR roles New-job announcement posts can be particularly useful because new hires sometimes tag and thank the people who interviewed, recruited, referred or hired them. The 30 companies I would like researched are: 1. Cognism 2. Attio 3. Legora 4. Metaview 5. Contentful 6. Staffbase 7. Airwallex 8. Contentsquare 9. GWI 10. Paddle 11. Pigment 12. Samsara 13. AlphaSense 14. Drata 15. Decagon 16. Snowflake 17. Databricks 18. Cloudflare 19. Braze 20. Box 21. Synthesia 22. Cognition 23. Vanta 24. HiBob 25. CUBE 26. Mirakl 27. Clay 28. n8n 29. Ramp 30. Semrush For each relevant contact, I need: * Full name * Current job title * Company * Location * LinkedIn profile URL * Verified work email * phone number where available All contacts must currently work at the company. For London-based roles, please prioritise people connected to the London/UK SDR/BDR team. For UK-remote SDR roles, prioritise people responsible for UK SDR/BDR hiring. Please do not add random employees simply to reach a certain number of contacts. If you find only 4–6 genuinely relevant people at a company, that is better than providing 12 weak contacts.WILL BE PAYING GOOD FOR EXPERT LEVEL PEOPLE
